fact: INSEED's Statistiques du Commerce Extérieur 2025 report, covering the year 2025 and so published after it, draws its figures from the customs information system (SYDONIA) through collaboration with the customs directorate DGDDI, and accompanies a 2000-2025 database to be enriched annually.
title: Statistiques du Commerce Extérieur 2025
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique, des Études Économiques et Démographiques (INSEED)
